text.en:
Act Numbered Twenty-four hundred and seventy-two of the Philippine Legislature, entitled "An
Act repealing Acts Numbered Eight hundred and seventeen, Eight hundred and thirty-four, and Twenty-one
hundred and twenty-one by changing the method of appointment of locust boards, and.by denning the relation
of the Bureau of Agriculture to locust boards, to be known as the 'Locust Act,' " is hereby made applicable to
the Department of Mindanao and Sulu.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, July 19, 1915.
